command: from pathlib import Path;import yaml,re;d=yaml.safe_load(Path('.github/workflows/ci.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));j=d['jobs'];assert set(j)=={'tooling','normal','fuzz','consumers','security','real-integration','summary'};assert j['summary']['if']=='always()';assert set(j['summary']['needs'])==set(j)-{'summary'};uses=[s['uses'] for job in j.values() for s in job.get('steps',[]) if 'uses' in s];assert all(re.fullmatch(r'actions/[a-z-]+@[0-9a-f]{40}',u) for u in uses);assert sum('download-artifact@' in s.get('uses','') for s in j['summary']['steps'])==8;assert d['permissions']=={'contents':'read'};print('PASS: YAML parsed; seven logical jobs; eight fixed downloads; always summary; pinned actions; contents read only')
commands.name: command
